field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: The cached model declaration prevents silent model or quantization substitution.
field_principles.abstention_rows: No-write rows prove ties and missing preferences do not update memory.
field_principles.action_receipt_rows: A durable action seal proves each outcome opened after all four actions.
field_principles.advantage_rows: Paired exact differences supply the sign for balanced updates.
field_principles.arm_rows: Frozen arm summaries prevent a treatment from disappearing after outcomes open.
field_principles.conflict_rows: Conflict evidence exposes deterministic replacement instead of hidden overwrite.
field_principles.cost_rows: An explicit local cost rule makes cost per event reproducible.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time exposes interruption and implausible model work.
field_principles.event_rows: Per-event actions support independent chronology and metric replay.
field_principles.execution_venue: The host venue prevents unattributed remote compute claims.
field_principles.field_principles: A reason for each required field makes missing evidence visible.
field_principles.flowbalance_memory_csl_complete_score: One requires all planned actions and terminal receipts, not uplift.
field_principles.flowbalance_training_reproduction: False prevents an external update rule from becoming a training claim.
field_principles.future_success_rows: Held-future exact success is the main value measurement.
field_principles.future_uplift_supported_score: One requires a positive paired lower bound with retained protected performance.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: The first failed expected-observed check makes a block actionable.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A class-matching prefix prevents completion from implying scientific uplift.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate states that a frozen local model produced every action.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The closed class separates full generation from a blocked no-run.
field_principles.latency_rows: Per-arm time shows the service cost of external memory.
field_principles.learning_curve_rows: Prefix success rates show when any future value appears or decays.
field_principles.memory_candidate_rows: Candidate rows expose retained, reversed, and rejected guidance.
field_principles.model_identity_rows: Path, revision, hash, backend, device, and template identify the invoked model.
field_principles.model_load_receipts: Live load and smoke receipts prove the declared model could generate.
field_principles.model_weights_changed: False isolates external memory from policy training.
field_principles.negative_transfer_rows: Paired losses expose cases where memory hurts a baseline success.
field_principles.outcome_reveal_rows: Delayed exact outcomes keep the verifier outside current action selection.
field_principles.paired_interval_rows: Paired intervals keep uncertainty attached to future uplift claims.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact preflight rows prevent a missing resource from becoming invented evidence.
field_principles.protected_retention_rows: Protected outcomes prevent future gains from hiding forgetting.
field_principles.random_seed: One fixed seed binds event-level decoding and deterministic conflict rules.
field_principles.refresh_rows: Sealed boundary rows prove refresh is bounded and chronological.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A canonical digest detects any later artifact mutation.
field_principles.rollback_rows: Parent restoration proves a failed publish cannot corrupt active memory.
field_principles.rows: The complete event-arm denominator prevents aggregate-only claims.
field_principles.run_date: The fixed execution date separates this run from later replays.
field_principles.signature_rows: Signatures detect any change to a memory record after admission.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind the result to exact stream, model, code, and solver bytes.
field_principles.stale_memory_rows: Harm after memory reuse reveals obsolete guidance.
field_principles.token_rows: Prompt and completion counts prove matched budgets and model dose.
field_principles.transaction_rows: Staged terminal receipts make every external state change auditable.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class separates complete null evidence from support or disqualification.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that the exact checker reveals outcomes but selects no action.
